description.value: Fixx Urban Grill is a locally owned full-service restaurant in Dawson Creek — the Mile 0 city of the Alaska Highway — that has been welcoming locals and travellers since 2012. The menu centres on premium AAA steaks cut in-house and aged 28 days, alongside seafood starters like halibut and crab spring rolls and a full range of salads and mains. Situated on Highway 2 between two hotels, it also offers banquet rooms for groups, making it a sit-down option at a major cycling waypoint.

The About Us and food menu pages confirm an active, locally owned full-service dine-in restaurant operating since 2012 with a broad menu and banquet facilities. No bike-specific amenities, washroom references, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appear anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null; the only amenity inferrable from the menu text is takeout, suggested by the 'Dine-in Only' qualifier on one menu item.
